Engineering teams are betting big on AI to change how they design and build products. But as AI and agentic solutions multiply one thing is becoming clear: context and control are the difference between general utility and engineering impact.


In physical engineering, missing context creates noticeable gaps in how agents operate and the stakes make that gap hard to ignore. An agent that doesn’t know your team or regulatory standards gets a battery cooling analysis wrong on a new EV, or misses a fatigue issue on an aircraft wing component. This inevitably creates problems that surface late in development, creates unnecessary redo work, or worse gets discovered after a product ships.


## What’s New in the Fall 2026 Showcase


Rescale’s[Fall Showcase Release](https://rescale.com/lp/fall-2026-product-showcase/) introduces new capabilities that address the context gap in enterprise AI and agentic tools and simplify how AI surrogate models are trained, deployed and used.


Our latest platform innovation is focused in three areas:


- **Agentic Engineering:** An engineering-specific harness where teams define the context, skills, tools, and guardrails agents operate within, across cloud and local environments.
- **AI Physics:** Self-service tools that make accurate surrogate models easier to build from your own simulation data and put them in the hands of design, test, and manufacturing engineers.
- **Compute Orchestration:** Visibility, prioritization, and cost controls that keep throughput high and spend in check as simulation and agentic workloads scale.


## Agentic Engineering: The Harness for Engineering Work


To work the way engineers work day-to-day, agents need access to what makes an engineering organization effective. That means its institutional knowledge; the handoffs between design, simulation, test, and manufacturing; and the intuition experienced engineers apply every day. Most of it is never written down, and much of it leaves when people move on.


Agents also need clear limits on what they can and can’t do, with defined points where an engineer’s judgment is required. Rescale’s new Agentic Projects give engineering teams the foundation for an engineering-specific harness built for the customization and control they need.


- **Agentic Projects:** Define the objectives, skills, tools, and guardrails that shape how Rescale’s AI assistant, Edison, orchestrates agents and executes to your organization’s standards. Project memory retains only the learnings engineers approve, and every recommended improvement is explicitly kept or removed. Agent nodes add custom agent steps to workflows, such as validating inputs, analyzing results, or preparing evidence. Teams save and share Agentic Projects across programs to keep standards and governance consistent.
- **Engineering Intelligence:** Turn historical data into structured, actionable insights. Knowledge graphs connect data from requirements, design, simulation, test, and process systems, giving agents the facts, relationships, and configurations they need for complex workflows. A work graph maps how people, data, and tasks connect across each workflow, so engineers and leaders can trace how work gets done and where agents play a role.
- **Rescale Desktop:** Extend Rescale’s engineering intelligence to the work that happens before and after simulation. Rescale Desktop brings Edison and Rescale’s engineering intelligence to engineers’ local machines, so agents can support pre- and post-processing, results analysis, and reporting alongside the desktop applications engineers already use. Files move between local and cloud environments, and Agentic Projects apply the same context, skills, and guardrails wherever the work runs.
- **Expanded MCP Connectors:** Put agents to work across your entire engineering toolset. Rescale’s expanded MCP connectors bring its specialized agents and 1,350+ pre-installed applications into tools like Anthropic Claude and other MCP-compatible tools. Rescale’s interoperability enables teams to run multi-step, multi-application workflows via Rescale from the tools they already use.


*Agentic Projects define the context, skills, tools, and guardrails agents work within, bringing together project goals, reusable skills, linked files, workflows, and jobs in one workspace.*


Together, these capabilities give agents the context and controls to work the way your engineers do, and the value builds with every program. As engineers provide agents more context and confirm learnings, Agentic Projects capture it in project memory and carry it forward, creating a recursive learning loop across your organization’s knowledge and processes. Now, agents start each new program with your team’s standards, methods, and objectives, so engineers spend less time documenting and prompting and spend more time on the analysis and decisions that matter. And throughout each project, acquired expertise stays with the organization instead of walking out the door, and that accumulated intelligence becomes a competitive edge.


## Customer Impact: Putting Agents to Work in High-Rigor Environments


Nuclear might be the toughest proving ground for agentic engineering. The multiphysics are complex, regulatory scrutiny is intense, and pressure to deliver clean, reliable power faster keeps growing.


Kairos Power and Oak Ridge National Laboratory’s Manufacturing Demonstration Facility (ORNL MDF) are putting Agentic Engineering on Rescale to work on Hermes 2, a 50 MW advanced reactor. Engineers approve every agent action. Kairos Power expects a 3x gain in end-to-end analysis efficiency while preserving the traceability regulators require.


Kairos Power’s staged path to future plants includes the Hermes Low-Power Demonstration Reactor, whose radiation shielding columns are built with concrete poured into 3D-printed forms developed in partnership with Oak Ridge National Laboratory.


Early results from the Kairos Power and ORNL MDF collaboration go beyond the expected analysis efficiency gain. Agents coordinating simulation and reporting end to end are compressing design validation cycles and widening the range of design candidates engineers can explore, with shared, real-time visibility across both teams. Capturing engineering context for agents also speeds up onboarding and manufacturing turnarounds. The collaboration shows something bigger, too: national lab expertise, encoded in agents, can reach private industry and accelerate U.S. innovation.


## Results Across Top-Tier Automotive Programs


- **A European OEM** is seeing a 3x boost in expert productivity. Agentic modeling workflows cut manual chassis modeling time 80%, saving roughly a week per workflow, and a specialized agentic workflow reduced virtual design evaluations from 36 days to 8 days per program.
- **A leading automotive manufacturer** reduced engineer workload 70% with a single agentic workflow that drafts the analysis plan, configures the job, recommends hardware, runs it, and generates reports. Because it draws on historical engineering knowledge connected through Rescale’s SharePoint integration, every job setup follows the company’s standards.


## AI Physics: Accelerate Time-to-Decision from Design to Production


AI physics is continuing to see increased acceptance among CAE teams with many building and testing surrogate models, but production-grade implementations often stall. Surrogate models are complex to build and take scarce AI/ML expertise to maintain. That keeps much of their value out of reach for the design, test, and manufacturing engineers who could benefit most.


Rescale’s AI Physics enhancements tackle both sides of the problem: making accurate models easier to deploy, and making them easier to ***build*** and ***use*** . That opens AI surrogate methods to a much wider group, from design engineers to downstream supply chain partners, with no need to be an AI/ML expert or data scientist to manage or use them.


## Easier to Build


- **Agentic dataset creation:** Start training faster with an agent that builds ready-to-run datasets from the simulation data you already have.
- **Guided pre-processing:** Prepare data step by step, with outliers identified, data splits recommended, and gaps surfaced before training begins.
- **Auto Tune:** Improve accuracy and performance by automatically adjusting model configurations during training, without manual fine tuning.


## Easier to Use


- **Design Explorer:** Put surrogate models directly in design engineers’ hands. A guided local interface lets them explore thousands of design options against constraints set by simulation engineers, and link multiple models into multiphysics optimization pipelines.
- **Uncertainty Quantification:** Every prediction comes with confidence and out-of-distribution signals, flagging which results need a full-fidelity check and when a model needs to be expanded.


*Design Explorer lets design engineers evaluate thousands of options against defined constraints, using a connected workflow of design variables, geometry, models, and scripts to compare results in one view.*


That combination of accuracy and usability is what enables production-grade use of AI surrogates across an organization and builds lasting confidence in them.


AI used alongside traditional CAE simulation is already making an impact. A leading automotive manufacturer used an AI surrogate model in place of full simulation which sped up design iterations 600x, from 5 hours to 30 seconds per design. Automated orchestration cut its virtual release cycle from 200 hours to 40 minutes for a typical batch of 40 designs. Time to a final qualified design dropped from 4 months to 2 weeks.


## Compute Orchestration: High Throughput and Efficient Economics at Scale


As compute operations scale, for both traditional simulation and agentic workloads, economics and throughput need as much attention as capability. And as agents submit more jobs on engineers’ behalf, administrators can’t afford to guess why a job is waiting or which queue is backing up.


Rescale’s new Compute Orchestration capabilities give engineering and IT leads the visibility and control to keep work moving:


- **Cluster performance metrics:** See where execution slows and why jobs are waiting, then address bottlenecks early to improve job performance and resource utilization.
- **Priority Score:** Allocate resources fairly based on wait time, job size, and resource usage, with administrative controls that let the highest-priority work launch when it’s needed.
- **Compute economics controls:** Rescale Savings Plans deliver on-prem-competitive economics with the flexibility and elasticity of the cloud. New speed dial controls let administrators decide when jobs should wait, burst, or fall back to alternate infrastructure.


*Cluster performance metrics show how jobs are performing and when Cluster performance metrics show how jobs are performing and when they get stuck, with live views of GPU and CPU utilization, memory usage, disk I/O, and network traffic.*


With the combination of these new features, the result is compute operations that run as a visible, policy-driven operating layer instead of a reactive admin task, keeping engineering productivity high and costs in check.


## *Harnessing* Engineering Knowledge as a Lasting Competitive Edge


Point agents are already everywhere in engineering. What separates the organizations that get real value from them is the context and control to customize how they work: agents that start from your knowledge, operate within your limits, and get better with every program.


The Fall 2026 Showcase gives R&D and engineering teams that foundation. Agentic Projects capture and grow your engineering intelligence. AI Physics brings accurate, easy-to-use surrogates to the engineers making design decisions. Compute Orchestration keeps it all running efficiently at scale.
